scenarios.fault: the leader's node stops abruptly (kvtest Kill: listener and loop gone, as SIGKILL)
scenarios.expected: the other two elect a leader in a higher term; writes succeed again within 3 s; linearizable; all converge after the old leader restarts
scenarios.observed: leader 3 killed; 1 leads in term 3; first write succeeded 1.31 s after the kill; history of 29940 operations (13 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 69d81ea1… at applied index 17963

scenarios.fault: one follower's node stops abruptly
scenarios.expected: no leader change; writes keep succeeding (majority intact); linearizable; the follower converges after restart
scenarios.observed: follower 1 killed; leader 3 unchanged; writes continued (first after the kill in 0.032 s); history of 28014 operations (2 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 79adda54… at applied index 16793

scenarios.fault: a follower is down while writes continue, then restarts over its own data
scenarios.expected: writes continue meanwhile; the follower catches up from the leader's log; linearizable; converged
scenarios.observed: follower 1 restarted 22912 entries behind; caught up in 0.70 s; history of 38108 operations (2 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash d1000087… at applied index 22916

scenarios.fault: two of three nodes stop (quorum lost), then one restarts
scenarios.expected: no write and no linearizable read succeeds without quorum; a serializable read is still served locally; once a second node is back, writes succeed again; linearizable; converged
scenarios.observed: with nodes [2 3] down: write rejected, linearizable read rejected (coordination: cluster unavailable: connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:58683: connect: connection refused"), serializable read served locally; node 2 restarted: writes succeeded 3.59 s later; history of 15038 operations (46 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 71146d98… at applied index 8975

scenarios.fault: a follower's data is replaced by an older copy of its own (taken earlier while stopped) and it restarts; the other two hold every committed entry
scenarios.expected: safety holds: no divergence, linearizable; the node rejoins behind and catches up (under the same leader, or after a leadership transfer: raft never lowers a peer's acknowledged progress)
scenarios.observed: node 1 restarted from a copy ending at index 2: caught up under the same leader; history of 47151 operations (0 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash c66079e6… at applied index 28302

scenarios.fault: 60% of peer messages held 1–3 ticks (up to 300 ms latency spikes, below the 1 s election timeout), via transport.Fault
scenarios.expected: writes keep succeeding, slower; elections stay stable; linearizable; converged once the delay ends
scenarios.observed: under delay: first write 0.30 s after it began, sequential write latency p50 99ms / max 300ms; leader 1 → 1, 0 term change(s); history of 13798 operations (3 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 616a71fb… at applied index 8279

scenarios.fault: the leader is cut off from both followers (transport.Fault partition)
scenarios.expected: the majority elects a leader and keeps accepting writes within 3 s; writes sent to the minority leader fail; after healing, the old leader follows and all converge; linearizable
scenarios.observed: leader 2 isolated: a write through it while it still led was not acknowledged; majority elected 1; writes succeeded 2.07 s after the cut; history of 27152 operations (6 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash e4721a64… at applied index 16277

scenarios.fault: every node stops abruptly, then all restart over their own data
scenarios.expected: state is preserved: a value written before is read back; writes succeed again; linearizable; converged
scenarios.observed: all three restarted; writes succeeded 1.27 s after the stop; the marker written before reads back; history of 14115 operations (13 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash e4cb38d5… at applied index 8438

scenarios.fault: every node is cut off from the others (three-way partition) while clients keep writing; then the partition heals
scenarios.expected: no write is acknowledged while no majority can talk; the leader steps down (CheckQuorum); after healing, writes succeed; writes that timed out are recorded as unknown (they may apply later); linearizable
scenarios.observed: three-way partition: 3 writes rejected; no node claims leadership; healed: writes succeeded 0.34 s later; history of 13823 operations (8 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 373637e6… at applied index 8278

scenarios.fault: 6 s of seeded chaos (random node kills and restarts, partitions and heals) under load, then everything heals
scenarios.expected: every node reaches the same state hash at the same applied index; linearizable
scenarios.observed: chaos: [isolate 1 kill 3 isolate 3 kill 2 kill 1 isolate 3 kill 2 kill 1 isolate 3 kill 1 isolate 1 kill 3]; writes succeeded 1.37 s after everything healed; history of 26512 operations (58 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash d6c17f29… at applied index 15859

scenarios.scenario: Snapshot restore of a wiped node
scenarios.fault: a follower's data is deleted (snapshot every 50 entries, 10 kept) and it restarts empty; leadership moves (the wipe procedure)
scenarios.expected: the node installs the leader's snapshot and catches up; state hashes equal; linearizable
scenarios.observed: node 1 wiped; after the transfer to 3 it installed a snapshot at index 351 and caught up 0.14 s after its restart; history of 678 operations (1 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash b61dedaf… at applied index 379

scenarios.scenario: Stale scheduler cannot act after a new epoch
scenarios.fault: the leading scheduler is cut off from Raft (a paused process) while another campaigns; then it wakes and makes the decision it had pending, with its old epoch
scenarios.expected: the other scheduler takes over within the 10 s target and its epoch is fenced in Postgres; the old leader's decision fails with STALE_EPOCH and commits nothing; committed epochs never decrease; the KV history is linearizable
scenarios.observed: scheduler-a (epoch 1) cut off; scheduler-b took over at epoch 2 after 6.84 s (TTL 6s, renew 2s); a's pending decision got STALE_EPOCH; 2 decisions over 2 terms, epochs never decreased; history of 54172 operations (1 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 81c3182e… at applied index 32503

scenarios.fault: each node in turn is killed and restarted while clients write
scenarios.expected: writes resume within the Raft failover target after each restart; no data loss; linearizable; converged
scenarios.observed: restarted nodes [1 2 3] one by one; slowest recovery 1.44 s; history of 14933 operations (37 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 4f3d3dfc… at applied index 8916

scenarios.fault: leadership is transferred 5 times while clients write
scenarios.expected: each transfer completes; writes resume within the Raft failover target; linearizable; converged
scenarios.observed: 5 transfers; slowest write recovery 0.12 s; history of 26656 operations (1 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 22767a9b… at applied index 16006

scenarios.fault: Raft node 1's clock runs 2 s ahead (it stamps commands and judges lease expiry while it leads); Raft leadership moves among the nodes every 1.5 s while two schedulers (3 s lease, renewed every 1 s) keep deciding
scenarios.expected: lease timing shifts (earlier or later expiry judgments) and scheduler leadership changes at least once, but safety holds through fencing: committed decision epochs never decrease; the KV history is linearizable
scenarios.observed: node 1 at +2 s; 8 Raft leadership moves; 222 decisions committed over 3 scheduler terms, 0 rejected as STALE_EPOCH; committed epochs never decreased; history of 90909 operations (1 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 7ac857a7… at applied index 54538

scenarios.fault: every node's fsync (storage Save) delayed by 40 ms
scenarios.expected: elections stay stable or recover; writes keep succeeding, slower; linearizable; converged
scenarios.observed: 40 ms fsync: writes succeeded 0.21 s after it began; leader 3 → 3, 0 term change(s); history of 14126 operations (3 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash 248c41aa… at applied index 8443

scenarios.fault: about 12 MiB of state (1,500 × 8 KiB values), then a follower is wiped and catches up through a multi-chunk snapshot while clients write
scenarios.expected: the snapshot installs (1 MiB chunks) without stalling writes; state hashes equal; linearizable
scenarios.observed: about 12 MiB of state; wiped node 1 installed snapshot at index 1801 and caught up 0.18 s after its restart, while writes continued; history of 885 operations (3 writes with unknown outcome) is linearizable; members [1 2 3] converged: state hash e4b68964… at applied index 2004

scenarios.scenario: Negative control: stale read reported as linearizable
scenarios.fault: a deliberately broken client: after v2 is acknowledged, it reads the key from a partitioned follower with SERIALIZABLE consistency and records it as a linearizable read
scenarios.expected: Porcupine flags the history as not linearizable (the checker works)
scenarios.observed: stale read of v1 after v2 was acknowledged: Porcupine judged the history Illegal
